### His Glory, Our Concern
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-march-25-2025.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 4:19-21
Points:
- Phinehas's wife suffered the grief of her husband's hypocrisy and death.
- In her final moments, God's honor mattered far more to her than temporal tragedy.
- Naming her son Ichabod testified to the spiritual disaster of the captured ark.
- Her dying response demonstrated that she had lived closely with the Lord.
- Believers experience genuine hope and freedom when God's glory is their primary concern.

### Ichabod
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/ichabod-one-year-devotions-for-men-september-8.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 4:21-22
Points:
- Israel's military defeat and the loss of the ark led directly to the deaths of Eli and his daughter-in-law.
- By naming her newborn Ichabod, the dying mother lamented that the glory had departed from the nation.
- Many places with a once-vibrant Christian heritage now lie in spiritual ruins.
- Faith is fragile and remains only one generation away from disappearance.
- The departure of God's presence begins with empty religious routine and inward moral compromise.
